name: Testbed closet lock
notes: The locked wooden door into the grey-box testbed's east closet (mw-e17.5): the testbed closet key lying on the floor nearby opens it from the keyring, with no menu. Without the key the Unlock prompt is greyed with the hint. A tier-1 latch a thief could pick at pick tier 1 (the minigame is mw-e10).
hint: Locked. The key can't be far.
